note.question: How do negative advertising and competitive positioning interact?
note.overview: Negative advertising provides information about the weaknesses of a competitor’s product. This paper studies negative advertising with a focus on how its regulation impacts product positioning for profit-maximizing firms. We build a model of informative advertising competition, where product positioning is endogenous, and consumers have rational expectations.
